en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a coastal landscape with a large gnarled tree in the right foreground, sloping grass with a few seated figures in hats, and a wooded peninsula extending into a calm body of water. Cypress trees and low hills line the shore. There is handwritten text around the image, both along the margins and across the bottom. At the lower left, in small print, appears a caption identifying the view.
